summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd, a Singapore-based marine fuel wholesaler listed on Nasdaq under UFG, furnished a Form 6-K on September 9, 2026, reporting unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine foreign private issuer earnings disclosure, the US equivalent of a domestic quarterly earnings release, not a special situation. Revenue rose to $197.1 million from $114.6 million, gross profit $5.34 million, net income $1.38 million, or $0.04 per Class A and Class B share, with total equity $11.88 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock is stated. No deal terms apply; watch only operating margin, accounts payable and liquidity.
